title: Initiative Orchestra: Conducting Cross-Functional Roadmaps and OKR Harmonization
creator: Maya Singh
description: Problem: Multiple orgs maintain separate initiative roadmaps and success measures which leads to duplicate work, misaligned priorities, and inconsistent OKR rollups. Goal: Create an "initiative orchestra" operating model and a lightweight Alignment Hub that codifies commitments, decision rights, SLAs for cross-team deliverables, and automates OKR rollups into a single company view. Deliverables: 1) Alignment Hub template (Confluence + spreadsheet + dashboard), 2) Initiative scorecard archetype mapped to company OKRs, 3) Weekly cross-functional cadence playbook (roles, agenda, escalation), 4) Commitment SLA rubric and rollback/compensating action playbook, 5) Pilot with 3 initiatives across product, infra, and growth.
acceptance_criteria: Alignment Hub page published with template and ownership matrix
Three pilot initiatives onboarded and tracked end-to-end for one cadence cycle
Dashboards show OKR rollup with source initiative mapping and % complete
Commitment SLA rubric reviewed and approved by Eng, Design, Security
Playbook includes runbook for deconfliction and escalation with named responders
risks_and_tradeoffs: Centralizing commitments may add perceived process overhead—mitigation: lightweight templates and a single weekly 30m sync
Automated rollups rely on disciplined tagging in Linear and PRs—mitigation: provide tagging helper and short training
Enforcing SLAs could cause friction if teams are already overloaded—mitigation: include buffer commits and capacity markers
rollout_plan: Week 1: Finalize Alignment Hub templates and scorecard columns; stakeholder review
Week 2: Build dashboard data pipeline (Linear tags -> dashboard) and demo to PM/Eng leads
Week 3: Onboard first pilot initiative (infra autoscaling) and iterate playbook
Week 4-6: Run two more pilots (console UX & growth targeting), capture feedback
Week 7: Publish playbook org-wide and schedule office hours for onboarding
